soldier: Head capsule of the soldier pale yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, thorax and abdomen yellowish white. Head capsule rectangular, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the frontal region shallowly concave, the Y-shaped suture indistinct. Antennal segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2. The apical margin of the labrum straight, the anterior lateral corners slightly rounded. Mandibles long and stout, the mandibular base prominent; the left mandible with five marginal teeth, the first broad and blunt, the second and fifth triangular and larger, the third and fourth short, blunt and small; the right mandible with two marginal teeth, very large. Eye spots small and flat, not protruding. Postmentum club-shaped, the anterior margin straight, the wide anterior region without a lobar incision, the waist distinctly contracted and narrow. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head capsule, the anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave, the lateral margins rounding out.
